failure_attribution.B: sparse knots anchor only note CORES; the inter-note transition region is left to pitd interpolation, so notes enter at the previous notes tail value instead of their own target (e.g. you enters -203c, de +588c in first 150ms). Steep linear-body slopes amplify the carry-over. Pitch.data y0 convention verified identical to human written values — not the cause. Design-level defect: transitions/departure/arrival regions need explicit structural anchors, not free interpolation.
failure_attribution.A: zero-expression baseline is flat by construction
